audience: managers of shops, restaurants and other shift-based teams who plan staff in Tamigo

useCases.title: Compare planned and worked hours
useCases.text: The AI reads per employee and day the original rota, the planned rota and the worked hours for a date range. You can check payroll and spot differences.

useCases.title: See who is absent and if it is approved
useCases.text: The AI lists absences such as holiday, sickness and leave that overlap a date range, with employee, department and approved or rejected state.

useCases.title: List employees with roles and contract hours
useCases.text: The AI lists employees with roles per department and, in the detailed list, contract hours, wage type and absence balances.

useCases.title: Check departments and opening hours
useCases.text: The AI lists departments with their keys and reads the normal and special opening hours of each for a date range.

useCases.title: Register attendance or upload daily revenue
useCases.text: The AI registers check-in and check-out times on the timesheet for one or many employees, or imports daily revenue per department.
